Arithmetic: 86,400 / 500 = 172.8 s ≈ 2.9 min ("about one every three minutes"); 500 / 86,400 ≈ 0.0058/s ≈ 0.006/s, about 1/570 of 3.3/s. Even if all 500 arrived within one hour, 500/3,600 ≈ 0.14/s, still far below 3.3/s.

Consistent with the file's structure: SA-4 measure on line 28 already names backup expiry ("bản trong backup hết khi backup hết hạn giữ"), and line 44 names the legal department as co-confirmer of the 30-day wait. Conditional recommendation, not stated as fact.

ADR 0026 lines 46-47: "Một cửa hàng chuyển khi chạm một trong hai điều kiện (giả định): giữ hơn 10% tổng số đơn của ngày đông nhất, hoặc cần khôi phục riêng theo hợp đồng." Round 2: section 7 now carries "(assumed)".

PostgreSQL 17, 25.1 SQL Dump (via WebFetch): "Dumps created by pg_dump are internally consistent, meaning, the dump represents a snapshot of the database at the time pg_dump began running." A later DELETE therefore does not alter a backup already taken; how long the copy lives is the backup's retention, as SA-4 line 28 states. Round 2: front matter now has versions_used: [postgresql], matching version_key.

Round 2: the exercise now states "one is taken each morning, before any deletion that day runs". 1 March + 30 days = 31 March (rows deleted); the 31 March morning backup holds the rows; + 14 days = 14 April. Quiz q2 now carries the same assumption: 1 April + 30 = 1 May; 1 May backup + 7 days = 8 May (key a).
